# Exceptions to scripts/check-public-wording.py, one per line:
#   path glob | rule (or *) | exact text on the line (or *) | reason
# The path glob is matched against a file path, "PR title", "PR body" or
# "commit <sha>". Every line needs a reason; keep the list short.
scripts/check-public-wording.py | * | * | the check's own patterns and messages
tests/unit/scripts/test_check_public_wording.py | * | * | test inputs for the check
* | host | bmsis.org | the maintainer's published contact address
tests/architecture/test_fixture_provenance.py | sol-ceiling | * | invented sols that test the archive envelope check
